name: adam reeves
bio: Croydon-born 18-year-old who can play left back or central defence. Joined in September 2026 on loan from Sutton United. Has also played for Hampton & Richmond Borough on loan

name: Ahkeem Belford
bio: 28-year-old Jamaican born right back, joined the Hawks in July 2026 from Phoenix Sports, where he was captain. Has also played for Beckenham Town and Ashford Town (Middlesex)

name: Beaux Booth
bio: Carshalton born 20-year-old signed in June 2026 from Lewes. After leaving Brentford in 2025, played for Sholing and Farnham Town. Attacking midfielder, assisted all three of the Rooks’ goals against the Hawks last season. Earlier in his career had two years in the Brighton & Hove Albion academy

name: Charlie Lambert
bio: Brighton born 26-year-old with over 170 appearances for the club, having first joined on loan from Eastbourne Borough in October 2021. Re-signed in December 2024 after a very short spell at Bognor Regis Town. Can play on the wing or down the middle. Top scorer in 25-26

name: Dan Bowry
bio: Croydon born 28-year-old signed for the Hawks in June 2026 from Cray Valley PM. Can play full back or in central defence. Began his career as a professional at Charlton Athletic. Has also played for Bath City, Wealdstone, Cheltenham Town, King’s Lynn Town, Worthing, St Albans City and Lewes. Capped 23 times by Antigua and Barbuda at international level. Father Bobby played for Millwall and Crystal Palace

name: Daneil Fosu
bio: Daniel signed for the Hawks in October 2026 after leaving Windsor & Eton. The 27-year-old Ghana-born attacking midfielder played professionally in Scotland for Arbroath and Peterhead. Also counts Havant & Waterlooville and Farnborough among his previous clubs

name: Eddie JIMENEZ
bio: Spanish born 17-year-old joined in September 2026 from Burgess Hill Town, who he played for in a Velocity Cup tie in 2025. Made his mark with a stunning strike against Lancing in the County Cup on his debut

name: eoin bolger
bio: Joined in August 2026 after three seasons at Walton & Hersham. 20-year-old Chertsey born defender who can also operate in midfield

name: Ethan McGrath
bio: Redhill born 19-year-old signed in the summer from East Grinstead Town. Had five years in the Brighton & Hove Albion academy before a scholarship at AFC Wimbledon

name: Ezra Ikebuasi
bio: Nigerian born 26-year-old right back who joined the Hawks from VCD Athletic in July 2026. Began his career at Braintree Town. Has also played for Chatham Town, Cheshunt and Met Police

name: Finlay Chadwick
bio: Holding midfielder with a long range shot who re-joined the Hawks in the summer of 2026 after leaving Bognor Regis Town where he was on joint registration from Worthing. Born in Chichester, the 22-year-old had a short spell on loan with the Hawks from Worthing in 2023. Has also played for Chichester City and Lewes

name: Grant Hall
bio: Vastly experienced ex-professional, Brighton-born central defender who joined in October 2025 after leaving Swindon Town. Counts Brighton & Hove Albion, Tottenham Hotspur, QPR, Middlesbrough and Rotherham United, as well as Lewes among his former clubs. The 34-year-old had a loan spell with the Hawks in 2010. Scored the goal of the season last year at Dulwich Hamlet. Appointed captain for the 26-27 season

name: Hugo Fisher
bio: 22-year-old Slovakian born keeper, joined in September 2026. Formerly with Brighton & Hove Albion’s Academy and Southampton. Played three times in the National League for Weymouth on loan in 2023

name: Hugo Odogwu-Atkinson
bio: Signed in March 2025 from Hendon, the 27-year-old established himself as a first-choice central defender, now converted into a left-back. Began his career as youth player at Tottenham Hotspur and has also played for Ebbsfleet United and Kingstonian

name: Imran Kayani
bio: 24-year-old Chertsey born winger re-signed in July 2026 for the third time. Scored 14 goals in his first season after joining from Dover Athletic. Started as an U18 player at Sutton United before playing for Slough Town. Has made seven appearances for Pakistan in World Cup qualifiers and also played for Cray Wanderers and Kingstonian

name: Joe Overy
bio: 19-year-old Eastbourne born wide attacker, re-signed in the summer, originally from Eastbourne Town. Played for Burgess Hill Town and the English Colleges team after leaving the Brighton & Hove Albion academy

name: Junior Nkwonta
bio: Ilford-born 22-year-old signed for the Hawks in October 2026. Counts Canvey Island, Aveley, Welling United, Hornchurch and Dagenham & Redbridge among his previous clubs. Began his career in the Manchester United academy

name: Kamarni Ryan
bio: 20-year-old London born striker signed in July 2026 from Redbridge. Started his career in the academies of Chelsea and Arsenal, before joining Burnley and playing in their U21 side last season

name: Klevis Muca
bio: 18-year-old Albanian born keeper signed on loan from National League Sutton United in August 2026. Played two games for Carshalton Athletic in the Isthmian Premier League in 24-25

name: Liam Moore
bio: 19-year-old attacking midfielder, joined the Hawks in the summer of 2026 from Sutton United. London born has played for Ashford Town and Cray Valley PM on loan. Began his career in the Crystal Palace academy

name: Luke Cook
bio: 23-year-old London born striker re-signed for the Hawks in October 2026 after leaving Gosport Borough. Started his career as a professional with Sheffield Wednesday and played briefly for the Hawks in February 2025. Has also played for Hanwell Town, Weymouth, Tonbridge Angels, Hendon and Carshalton Athletic

name: Luke Robinson
bio: Bermudan international re-signed for the Hawks for the third time in March 2026 after a spell out of the game with injury. The 27-year-old has also played for Horsham and Worthing, as well as professionally in Gibraltar

name: Matt Jones
bio: Joined in summer 2026 from Bognor Regis Town. The 30-year-old Swindon born left sided defender started his career with his hometown club, where he made once appearance in League One. Has also played for Chippenham Town, Farnborough, Hungerford Town and Weston-super-Mare. Works full-time as a sports teacher with Brighton & Hove Albion. His Dad Tom made over 200 appearance for Swindon Town

name: Mehmet Halim
bio: 19-year-old Croydon born striker joined the Hawks in the summer of 2026 from Sutton United. Previously a scholar at West Ham United. Played on loan last season at Leatherhead

name: Morgan Elliott
bio: 20-year-old defender or winger signed in July 2026 from Southall. Born in Japan, he started his career at Aldershot Town. Has also played for Bracknell Town or Ascot United

name: Nikolai Krokhin
bio: 25-year-old central defender signed from Lewes in August 2026. Has played for Hastings United, Sheppey United, Tooting & Mitcham United, Cheshunt, Hendon and Carshalton Athletic

name: Rhys Murphy
bio: Shoreham born experienced 35-year-old central striker signed from Horsham in August 2026. Started his career at Arsenal and played in the football league for Brentford, Preston North End, Dagenham & Redbridge, Oldham Athletic, Crawley Town, Forest Green Rovers and Gillingham, followed by National League clubs Torquay United, York City, Yeovil Town and Southend United. Earlier in his career he played for Telstar in the Netherlands as well as England at U16 to U19 level

name: seokjae lee
bio: 23-year-old attacking midfielder born in South Korea, joined from Bognor Regis Town in the summer of 2026. Started in Portsmouth’s U18 and has also played for Gosport Borough, Salisbury, Worthing, Chichester City and Havant & Waterlooville

name: Tresor Difika
bio: 22-year-old signed for the Hawks in October 2026. Has also played for South Park and Three Bridges

name: victor aiye
bio: 25-year-old Lewisham-born attacking midfielder, joined in August 2025 from Bishop’s Stortford. Has also played for Phoenix Sports, Sheppey United, Crowborough Athletic and VCD

name: yannis drais
bio: 32-year-old midfielder signed from Eastbourne Borough in September 2026. Played in his native France before joining Aldershot Town in 2020. Has also appeared for Dover Athletic, Welling United, Herne Bay and Uxbridge
